newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - USA Detergents lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - USA Detergents lowered.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities said analyst Michael Grant downgraded USA Detergents Inc to market performer from buy and suspended earnings per share estimates pending further information form the company.

-- Late Thursday the company said it does not know whether it will be profitable for the first quarter or the extent of its profits, since its results will be hurt by the buildup of manufacturing and distribution capacity.
